listing.summary: Upstream claims all offline modes 60fps and two-PC online tests; broader hardware not verified See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA PSN NPUB30009 01.00; owned 619430240-byte PKG + 16-byte RAP; disc/EU/JP refused

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release 1.1.4 launcher ZIP with its bundled compiler and runtime. Setup translates and builds from your own game files locally. Keep the resulting installed data with that runtime.
